## About
Hollywood Transmission works on just one thing: transmissions. The shop has stayed at the same spot on N Vermont Ave the whole time, and our president Charlie Choi leads the team.
We diagnose and repair or rebuild transmissions on front wheel drive, rear wheel drive and all wheel drive cars and trucks, plus vans and buses. Our mission is to repair your transmission into a perfect condition.
We'd rather see your car early, while there are fewer damaged parts. Sometimes all it needs is a routine transmission service. And we consider a referral the highest compliment you can give us.

## Services
- 3 Step Diagnosis: A transmission fluid check, a computer diagnosis and a drive test, so we know what's actually going on before we talk about repairs.
- Transmission Repairs and Re-Built Transmissions: We replace all damaged parts along with new soft components (rubber, plastic and clutches), then reinstall your transmission in your car.
- Front wheel drive trans axles and CVT transmissions: Front wheel drive cars and trucks, both regular trans axles and CVT transmissions.
- Rear wheel drive and heavy duty transmissions: Rear wheel drive cars, trucks, vans and buses, regular and heavy duty.
- All wheel drive and 4 wheel drive: All wheel drive and 4 wheel drive cars and trucks.
- Routine transmission service: Caught early, a problem can come down to a routine transmission service instead of a bigger repair.
- Wholesale deals: For shops looking for transmission deals for their clients. Contact one of our service managers. We ask for a copy of your automotive business license and resellers permit. Email info@hollywoodtrans.com for details.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge to look at my car?
A: No. We offer a free diagnosis, and we give you a free accurate estimate before any work is performed on your vehicle.

Q: This is my only car. How fast can you get it back to me?
A: Let us know your situation up front. We will go out of our way to have your vehicle back to you within two days.

Q: Can you tow my car to the shop?
A: Yes. We offer free towing up to 15 miles when you repair your transmission with us.

Q: Is there anything I can check on my own?
A: Check for leaks. Each time you take the car out, look underneath where it has been sitting. If you see a leak, have it fixed. It may not be the transmission, but it matters.
